channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Four-vehicle crash causes delays on A47
item.description: Traffic is currently moving slowly on a stretch of the A47 following a four-vehicle crash on the Acle Straight.

item.title: Fine City or scruffy sprawl? Time to tidy Norwich as City Hall told 'get a grip'
item.description: Norwich City Council has agreed to spend £313,000 on projects aimed at cleaning the city after members of the public said tidying the streets was a key priority.

item.title: Proposed livestock market move runs into difficulties already
item.description: Villagers in North Tuddenham fear plans to move Norwich's livestock market to land off Fox Lane could lead to traffic woes and safety issues in the surrounding area.

item.title: Glow-in-the-dark adrenaline-fuelled experience to 'go nuts in' coming to the city
item.description: A new UV paint room is launching at Rage Rooms, an event space relocating to Lothian Street near Norwich's Bowling House.

item.title: Revealed: Where more than 20 new schools are needed to cope with thousands of homes
item.description: More than 20 new Norfolk schools - at a cost of almost £400m - will be needed in to cope with families moving into thousands of planned new homes in the county.

item.title: Hidden underground space in the Lanes to be unlocked
item.description: A former wine cellar, hidden beneath the Norwich Lanes, is set to be opened up to the public by The Shoebox Experiences, a city tour company.

item.title: Sofa business owner dubs new retail store a 'game changer'
item.description: The owner of Holbrook Sofa Company says the business' first three months at the Royal Arcade in Norwich have gone "really well".

item.title: New rural campsite given the go-ahead for tents and campervans
item.description: A new campsite for tents and campervans has been given the go-ahead in rural Norfolk.

item.title: Inspiring John is talking my language - and I hope he encourages you too
item.description: One of the great pleasures for me in writing this weekly column is the feedback I receive from you, the readers.

item.title: Popular riverside picnic spot undergoes rebrand
item.description: St Helen's, near Santon Downham in Thetford Forest, will now be called Santon Historical Site.
